name: PPC Open Job Pool
query:
SELECT
  jc.name AS `Job Card:Link/Job Card Computer Paper:160`,
  jc.customer AS `Customer:Data:200`,
  jc.specification_name AS `Specification:Data:200`,
  jc.due_date AS `Due:Date:100`,
  jc.priority AS `Priority:Data:100`,
  jc.job_status AS `Status:Data:120`,
  jc.quantity_ordered AS `Cartons Ordered:Float:120`,
  jc.packing AS `Sets/Carton:Float:100`,
  jc.number_of_parts AS `Parts:Int:60`,
  jc.printed_quantity AS `Printed Sets:Float:110`,
  jc.collated_quantity AS `Collated Sets:Float:110`,
  jc.numbered_quantity AS `Numbered Sets:Float:120`,
  jc.packed_cartons AS `Packed:Int:90`,
  jc.plate_status AS `Plate:Data:80`,
  jc.plates_confirmed AS `Plates OK:Check:80`
FROM `tabJob Card Computer Paper` jc
WHERE jc.docstatus < 2
  AND jc.job_status IN ('Open','Planned','In Production','Packing Pending','On Hold')
ORDER BY
  CASE jc.priority WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'Urgent' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  CASE jc.job_status WHEN 'In Production' THEN 1 WHEN 'Packing Pending' THEN 2 WHEN 'Planned' THEN 3 WHEN 'On Hold' THEN 5 ELSE 4 END,
  jc.due_date ASC,
  jc.creation DESC
